description: This file contains utility functions and decorators for caching mechanisms within the Superset project, including cache key generation, setting cache with logging, memoization, and HTTP response caching with ETag support.

methods.name: generate_cache_key
methods.description: Generates a cache key string based on a dictionary of values, optionally prefixed.

methods.name: set_and_log_cache
methods.description: Sets a cache value with logging and optional database recording, respecting cache timeout and NullCache.

methods.name: memoized_func
methods.description: Decorator factory for caching function results with customizable key, cache backend, and options for forcing refresh and cache timeout.

methods.name: etag_cache
methods.description: Decorator for caching Flask view responses with ETag, Last-Modified, and conditional request handling.
